submitted.rationale: Index 22 (Bi0.43 Fe0.16 V0.41) is close to BiVO4 stoichiometry and has the least Fe of the Bi≈V candidates. Its XRD pattern is dominated by the monoclinic BiVO4 (121) reflection at Q≈2.04 Å⁻¹. It gave the highest measured photocurrent, 5.3e-7 A. The other two measurements came out lower. Adding Fe (idx 61) cut the photocurrent. Moving to the Bi-rich, V-poor side (idx 71) also cut it. So the best composition is near 1:1 Bi:V with minimal Fe.
